column1: Story,[MHAI-001] Project foundation,"Create Android Kotlin/Compose and FastAPI foundations, typed contracts, environment examples, and setup docs.
Story,[MHAI-002] Local data model and offline repository,"Define Room entities for documents, extracted fields, medicines, review events, and sync state. Preserve unknown status.
Kiro prompt: docs/jira/kiro-prompts/mhai-002-implementation.md",Records persist and view offline
Story,[MHAI-003] Prescription capture and import,"Implement CameraX capture and image/PDF import. Preserve original files and handle invalid/large files safely.
Story,[MHAI-004] Document library,"Build searchable/filterable library by date, type, and doctor label, with preview and extraction status.
Story,[MHAI-005] OCR extraction service,"Add provider-neutral OCR interface returning typed fields, confidence, and source location where available.
Story,[MHAI-006] OCR review UI,"Show original beside extracted fields, confidence/review state, edit/save actions. Keep raw OCR separate from normalized data.

column3: handle ambiguous mappings and combination products.

column1: Kiro prompt: docs/jira/kiro-prompts/mhai-007-implementation.md",Verified mappings return ingredient IDs
Story,[MHAI-008] Medication history,"Show history grouped by current/past/unknown, source, date, strength, and review status.
Kiro prompt: docs/jira/kiro-prompts/mhai-008-implementation.md",Every medicine links to source
Story,[MHAI-009] Duplicate matching engine,"Compare verified ingredient IDs and show source dates, strengths, formulation, and mapping status.
Story,[MHAI-010] Duplicate review UI,"Show side-by-side findings with ingredient evidence, strength/date differences, and source links.
Story,[MHAI-011] New Doctor Mode,"Build report builder with patient-entered details, confirmed allergies/conditions, medicine statuses, duplicate findings, reports, and source index.
Story,[MHAI-012] PDF export,"Generate readable PDF with selected sections, date, source index, limitations, and explicit share confirmation.
Story,[MHAI-013] Account and authentication,"Implement authentication, session handling, and server-side patient-scoped authorization.
Story,[MHAI-014] Encrypted cloud backup,"Implement opt-in backup, authenticated upload/download, encrypted object storage, retryable sync, and status.
Story,[MHAI-015] Conflict-safe sync,"Add versioning and conflict resolution for edits, extraction versions, deletion markers, and retryable jobs.
Kiro prompt: docs/jira/kiro-prompts/mhai-015-implementation.md",Confirmed edits not silently overwritten
Story,[MHAI-016] Privacy controls,"Implement backup opt-in/out, export, deletion of local/cloud records, and retention explanations.
Story,[MHAI-017] Consent-based sharing,"Share selected records/report after preview and explicit confirmation
Story,[MHAI-018] Security and privacy testing,"Test cross-account access, IDOR, secrets, sensitive logs, local file exposure, transport, and deletion.
Kiro prompt: docs/jira/kiro-prompts/mhai-018-implementation.md",No critical/high issue remains for release
Story,[MHAI-019] Accessibility and resilience,"Add scalable text, TalkBack labels, contrast, touch targets, offline/error/loading states, low-storage handling.
Story,[MHAI-020] MVP release readiness,"Run end-to-end workflows with synthetic data
column2: validate backup, report export, duplicate findings, deletion, accessibility, release notes.
